14.3.s: ayam̐ sahasramr̥ṣibʰiḥ sahaskr̥taḥ samudra iva papratʰe satyaḥ so asya mahimā gr̥ṇe śavo yajñeṣu viprarājye
14.3.d: अयꣳ सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये
14.3.e: Love of what is and what shall be, Agni, in his beloved forms, Shines forth alone as sovran Lord. I Agni

14.3.s: yasyāyaṃ viśva āryo dāsaḥ śevadʰipā ariḥ tiraścidarye ruśame pavīravi tubʰyetso ajyate rayiḥ
14.3.d: यस्यायं विश्व आर्यो दासः शेवधिपा अरिः तिरश्चिदर्ये रुशमे पवीरवि तुभ्येत्सो अज्यते रयिः
14.3.e: Wise Agni, in the ancient way, making his body beautiful, Hath been exalted by the sage.

14.3.s: turaṇyavo madʰumantaṃ gʰr̥taścataṃ viprāso arkamānr̥cuḥ asme rayiḥ papratʰe vr̥ṣṇyaṃ śavo 'sme svānāsa indavaḥ
14.3.d: तुरण्यवो मधुमन्तं घृतश्चतं विप्रासो अर्कमानृचुः अस्मे रयिः पप्रथे वृष्ण्यं शवो ऽस्मे स्वानास इन्दवः
14.3.e: I invocate the Child of Strength, Agni whose glow is bright and pure, In this well-ordered sacrifice.

14.3.s: gomanna indo aśvavatsutaḥ sudakṣa dʰaniva śuciṃ ca varṇamadʰi goṣu dʰārya
14.3.d: गोमन्न इन्दो अश्ववत्सुतः सुदक्ष धनिव शुचिं च वर्णमधि गोषु धार्य
14.3.e: So, Agni, rich in many friends, with fiery splendour seat thyself. With Gods upon our sacred grass! II Soma Pavamana

14.3.s: sa no harīṇāṃ pata indo devapsarastamaḥ sakʰeva sakʰye naryo ruce bʰava
14.3.d: स नो हरीणां पत इन्दो देवप्सरस्तमः सखेव सख्ये नर्यो रुचे भव
14.3.e: O thou with stones for arms, thy powers, rending the fiends, have raised themselves: Drive off the foes who compass us

14.3.s: sanemi tvamasmadā adevaṃ kaṃ cidatriṇam sāhvām̐ indo pari bādʰo apa dvayum
14.3.d: सनेमि त्वमस्मदा अदेवं कं चिदत्रिणम् साह्वाꣳ इन्दो परि बाधो अप द्वयुम्
14.3.e: Hence conquering with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked, With fearless heart will I sing praise.

14.3.s: añjate vyañjate samañjate kratum̐ rihanti madʰvābʰyañjate sindʰoru 'ccʰvāse patayantamukṣaṇam̐ hiraṇyapāvāḥ paśumapsu gr̥bʰṇate
14.3.d: अञ्जते व्यञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुꣳ रिहन्ति मध्वाभ्यञ्जते सिन्धोरु ऽच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणꣳ हिरण्यपावाः पशुमप्सु गृभ्णते
14.3.e: None, evil-minded, may assail this Pavamana's holy laws Crush him who fain would fight with thee!

14.3.s: vipaścite pavamānāya gāyata mahī na dʰārātyandʰo arṣati ahirna jūrṇāmati sarpati tvacamatyo na krīḍannasaradvr̥ṣā hariḥ
14.3.d: विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत मही न धारात्यन्धो अर्षति अहिर्न जूर्णामति सर्पति त्वचमत्यो न क्रीडन्नसरद्वृषा हरिः
14.3.e: For Indra to the streams they urge the tawny rapture-dropping steed, Indu, the bringer of delight. III Indra

14.3.s: agrego rājāpyastaviṣyate vimāno ahnāṃ bʰuvaneṣvarpitaḥ harirgʰr̥tasnuḥ sudr̥śīko arṇavo jyotīratʰaḥ pavate rāya okyaḥ
14.3.d: अग्रेगो राजाप्यस्तविष्यते विमानो अह्नां भुवनेष्वर्पितः हरिर्घृतस्नुः सुदृशीको अर्णवो ज्योतीरथः पवते राय ओक्यः
14.3.e: Come hither, Indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacocks' plumes! Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands!

14.3.s: viśvebʰiragne agnibʰirimaṃ yajñamidaṃ vacaḥ cano gʰāḥ sahasā yaho
14.3.d: विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिमं यज्ञमिदं वचः चनो घाः सहसा यहो
14.3.e: Vritra's devourer, he who burst the cloud, brake forts, and drave the floods, Indra, who mounts his chariot at his bay steeds' cry, shatters e'en things that stand most firm.

14.3.s: yacciddʰi śaśvā tanā devaṃdevaṃ yajāmahe tve iddʰūyate haviḥ
14.3.d: यच्चिद्धि शश्वा तना देवंदेवं यजामहे त्वे इद्धूयते हविः
14.3.e: Like pools of water deep and full, like kine thou cherishest thy might; Like the milch-cows that go well-guarded to the mead, like water-brooks that reach the lake. IV Indra

14.3.s: priyo no astu viśpatirhotā mandro vareṇyaḥ priyāḥ svagnayo vayam
14.3.d: प्रियो नो अस्तु विश्पतिर्होता मन्द्रो वरेण्यः प्रियाः स्वग्नयो वयम्
14.3.e: Even as the wild bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool, Come hither quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill!

14.3.s: indraṃ vo viśvataspari havāmahe janebʰyaḥ asmākamastu kevalaḥ
14.3.d: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः अस्माकमस्तु केवलः
14.3.e: May the drops gladden thee, Lord Indra, and obtain bounty for him who pours the juice! Soma, shed in the press, thou stolest and didst drink, and hence hast won surpassing might. V Indra I. Thou as a God. O mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.

14.3.s: sa no vr̥ṣannamuṃ carum̐ satrādāvannapā vr̥dʰi asmabʰyamapratiṣkutaḥ
14.3.d: स नो वृषन्नमुं चरुꣳ सत्रादावन्नपा वृधि अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः
14.3.e: Let not thy bounteous gifts, let not thy saving help all fail us good Lord, at any time! And measure out to us, thou lover of man-kind, all riches hitherward from men VI Dawn I. This Lady, excellent and kind, after her sister shining forth, Daughter of Heaven, hath shown herself.

14.3.s: br̥ṣā yūtʰeva vam̐sagaḥ kr̥ṣṭīriyartyojasā īśāno apratiṣkutaḥ
14.3.d: बृषा यूथेव वꣳसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः
14.3.e: Red, like a mare, and beautiful, holy, the mother of the kine, The Dawn became the Asvins' friend.

14.3.s: tvaṃ naścitra ūtyā vaso rādʰām̐si codaya asya rāyastvamagne ratʰīrasi vidā gādʰaṃ tuce tu naḥ
14.3.d: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधाꣳसि चोदय अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः
14.3.e: Yea, and thou art the Asvins', friend the mother of the cows art thou: O Dawn, thou rules over wealth VII Asvins

14.3.s: parṣi tokaṃ tanayaṃ partr̥bʰiṣṭvamadabdʰairaprayutvabʰiḥ agne heḍām̐si daivyā yuyodʰi no 'devāni harām̐si ca
14.3.d: पर्षि तोकं तनयं पर्तृभिष्ट्वमदब्धैरप्रयुत्वभिः अग्ने हेडाꣳसि दैव्या युयोधि नो ऽदेवानि हराꣳसि च
14.3.e: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise

14.3.s: kimitte viṣṇo paricakṣi nāma pra yadvavakṣe śipiviṣṭo asmi mā varpo asmadapa gūha etadyadanyarūpaḥ samitʰe babʰūtʰa
14.3.d: किमित्ते विष्णो परिचक्षि नाम प्र यद्ववक्षे शिपिविष्टो अस्मि मा वर्पो अस्मदप गूह एतद्यदन्यरूपः समिथे बभूथ
14.3.e: Children of Ocean, mighty ones, discoverers of riches, Gods, Finders of treasure through our prayer!

14.3.s: pra tatte adya śipiviṣṭa havyamaryaḥ śam̐sāmi vayunāni vidvān taṃ tvā gr̥ṇāmi tavasamatavyānkṣayantamasya rajasaḥ parāke
14.3.d: प्र तत्ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट हव्यमर्यः शꣳसामि वयुनानि विद्वान् तं त्वा गृणामि तवसमतव्यान्क्षयन्तमस्य रजसः पराके
14.3.e: Your lofty coursers hasten over the everlasting realm, whea your car flies with winged steeds. VIII Dawn

14.3.s: vaṣaṭ te viṣṇavāsa ā kr̥ṇomi tanme juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam vardʰantu tvā suṣṭutayo giri me yūyaṃ pāta svastabʰiḥ sadā naḥ
14.3.d: वषट् ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम् वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरि मे यूयं पात स्वस्तभिः सदा नः
14.3.e: O Dawn who hast a store of wealth, bring unto us that splendid gift Wherewith we may support children and children's sons

14.3.s: vāyo śukro ayāmi te madʰvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣu ā yāhi somapītaye spārho deva niyutvatā
14.3.d: वायो शुक्रो अयामि ते मध्वो अग्रं दिविष्टिषु आ याहि सोमपीतये स्पार्हो देव नियुत्वता
14.3.e: Thou radiant Lady of sweet strains, with wealth of horses and of kine Shine thou on us this day, O Dawn, auspiciously

14.3.s: indraśca vāyaveṣām̐ somānāṃ pītimarhatʰaḥ yuvām̐ hi yantīndavo nimnamāpo na sadʰryak
14.3.d: इन्द्रश्च वायवेषाꣳ सोमानां पीतिमर्हथः युवाꣳ हि यन्तीन्दवो निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक्
14.3.e: O Dawn who hast a store of wealth, yoke red steeds to thy car to-day. Then bring us all delight and all felicities IX Asvins

14.3.s: vāyavindraśca śuṣmiṇā saratʰam̐ śavasaspatī niyutvantā na ūtaya ā yātam̐ somapītaye
14.3.d: वायविन्द्रश्च शुष्मिणा सरथꣳ शवसस्पती नियुत्वन्ता न ऊतय आ यातꣳ सोमपीतये
14.3.e: O Asvins, wonderful in act, do ye unanimous direct Your chariot to our home wealthy in kine and gold!

14.3.s: adʰa kṣapā pariṣkr̥to vājām̐ abʰi pra gāhate yadī vivasvato dʰiyo harim̐ hinvanti yātave
14.3.d: अध क्षपा परिष्कृतो वाजाꣳ अभि प्र गाहते यदी विवस्वतो धियो हरिꣳ हिन्वन्ति यातवे
14.3.e: Hither may they who wake at dawn bring, to drink Soma, both the Gods, Health-givers, wonder-workers, borne on paths of gold!

14.3.s: tamasya marjayāmasi mado ya indrapātamaḥ yaṃ gāva āsabʰirdadʰuḥ purā nūnaṃ ca sūrayaḥ
14.3.d: तमस्य मर्जयामसि मदो य इन्द्रपातमः यं गाव आसभिर्दधुः पुरा नूनं च सूरयः
14.3.e: Ye who brought down the hymn from heaven, a light that giveth light to men, Do ye, O Asvins, bring strength hither unto us! X Agni

14.3.s: taṃ gātʰayā purāṇyā punānamabʰyanūṣata uto kr̥panta dʰītayo devānāṃ nāma bibʰratīḥ
14.3.d: तं गाथया पुराण्या पुनानमभ्यनूषत उतो कृपन्त धीतयो देवानां नाम बिभ्रतीः
14.3.e: I think of Agni who is kind, whom, as their home, the milch-kine seek; Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring, steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

14.3.s: aśvaṃ na tvā vāravantaṃ vandadʰyā agniṃ namobʰiḥ samrājantamadʰvarāṇām
14.3.d: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम्
14.3.e: For Agni, God of all mankind, gives the strong courser to theman. Agni gives ready gear for wealth, he gives the best when he ix pleased. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

14.3.s: sa gʰā naḥ sūnuḥ śavasā pr̥tʰupragāmā suśevaḥ mīḍʰvām̐ asmākaṃ babʰūyāt
14.3.d: स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पृथुप्रगामा सुशेवः मीढ्वाꣳ अस्माकं बभूयात्
14.3.e: The Agni who is praised as kind, to whom the milch-kine come. in herds, To whom the racers, swift of foot, to whom our wellborn princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise! XI Dawn

14.3.s: sa no dūrāccāsācca ni martyādagʰāyoḥ pāhi sadamidviśvāyuḥ
14.3.d: स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः पाहि सदमिद्विश्वायुः
14.3.e: O heavenly Dawn, awaken us to ample opulence today, Even as thou didst waken us with Satyasravas, Vayya's, Son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

14.3.s: tvamindra pratūrtiṣvabʰi viśvā asi spr̥dʰaḥ aśastihā janitā vr̥tratūrasi tvaṃ tūrya taruṣyataḥ
14.3.d: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः अशस्तिहा जनिता वृत्रतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः
14.3.e: Daughter of heaven, thou dawnedst of Sunitha, Suchadratha's son; So dawn thou on one mightier still, on Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

14.3.s: anu te śuṣmaṃ turayantamīyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṃ na mātarā viśvāste spr̥dʰaḥ śnatʰayanta manyave vr̥traṃ yadindra tūrvasi
14.3.d: अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि
14.3.e: So bringing treasure, shine to-day on us, thou daughter, of the Sky, As on one mightier thou hast dawned, on Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds! XII Asvins

14.3.s: yajña indramavardʰayadyadbʰūmiṃ vyavartayat cakrāṇa opaśaṃ divi
14.3.d: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् चक्राण ओपशं दिवि
14.3.e: To meet your treasure-bringing car, the car that is most dear to us, Asvins the Rishi is prepared, your worshipper with, songs of praise. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call

14.3.s: vyā3ntarikṣamatiranmade somasya rocanā indro yadabʰinadvalam
14.3.d: व्या३न्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना इन्द्रो यदभिनद्वलम्
14.3.e: Pass, Asvins, over all away. May I obtain you for myself, Wonderful, with your golden paths, most gracious, bringers of the flood! Lovers of sweetness, hear my call!

14.3.s: udagā ājadaṅgirobʰya āviṣkr̥ṇvanguhā satīḥ arvāñcaṃ nunude valam
14.3.d: उदगा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम्
14.3.e: Come to us, O ye Asvins twain, bringing your precious treasures, come Ye Rudras, on your paths of gold, rejoicing, with your store of wealth! Lovers of sweetness, hear my call! XIII Agni

14.3.s: tyamu vaḥ satrāsāhaṃ viśvāsu gīrṣvāyatam ā cyāvayasyūtaye
14.3.d: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् आ च्यावयस्यूतये
14.3.e: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames mounting to the vault of heaven.

14.3.s: yudʰmam̐ santamanarvāṇam̐ somapāmanapacyutam naramavāryakratum
14.3.d: युध्मꣳ सन्तमनर्वाणꣳ सोमपामनपच्युतम् नरमवार्यक्रतुम्
14.3.e: For the Gods' worship hath the priest been wakened: kind Agni hath arisen erect at morning. Kindled, his radiant might is made apparent, and the great God hath been set free from darkness.

14.3.s: śikṣā ṇa indra rāya ā puru vidvām̐ r̥cīṣama avā naḥ pārye dʰane
14.3.d: शिक्षा ण इन्द्र राय आ पुरु विद्वाꣳ ऋचीषम अवा नः पार्ये धने
14.3.e: When he hath roused the line of his attendants, with the bright milk bright Agni is anointed. Then is prepared the effectual oblation, which spread in front, with tongues, erect, he drinketh, XIV Dawn

14.3.s: tava tyadindriyaṃ br̥hattava dakṣmamuta kratum vajram̐ śiśāti dʰiṣaṇā vareṇyam
14.3.d: तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत्तव दक्ष्ममुत क्रतुम् वज्रꣳ शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम्
14.3.e: This light is come, amid all lights the fairest: born is the brilliant, far-extending brightness. Night, sent away for Savitar's uprising, hath yielded up a birthplace for the morning.

14.3.s: tava dyaurindra paum̐syaṃ pr̥tʰivī vardʰati śravaḥ tvāmāpaḥ parvatāsaśca hinvire
14.3.d: तव द्यौरिन्द्र पौꣳस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे
14.3.e: The fair, the bright is come with her white offspring to her the Dark one hath resigned her dwelling. Akin, immortal, following each other, changing their colours both the heavens move onward.

14.3.s: tvāṃ viṣṇurbr̥hankṣayo mitro gr̥ṇāti varuṇaḥ tvām̐ śardʰo madatyanu mārutam
14.3.d: त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः त्वाꣳ शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम्
14.3.e: Common, unending is the sisters' pathway: taught by the Gods alternately they travel, Fair-formed, of different hues and yet one-minded, Night and Dawn clash not, neither do they tarry. XV Asvins

14.3.s: namaste agna ojase gr̥ṇanti deva kr̥ṣṭayaḥ amairamitramardaya
14.3.d: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः अमैरमित्रमर्दय
14.3.e: Agni, the bright face of the Dawns, is shining: the singers' pious voices have ascended. Borne on your chariot, Asvins, turn you hither, and come unto our brimming warm libation!

14.3.s: kuvitsu no gaviṣṭaye 'gne saṃveṣiṣo rayim urukr̥duru ṇaskr̥dʰi
14.3.d: कुवित्सु नो गविष्टये ऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिम् उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि
14.3.e: Most frequent guests, they scorn not what is ready: even now the lauded Asvins are beside us. With promptest aid they come at morn and evening, the worshipper's most healthful guards from trouble.

14.3.s: mā no agne mahādʰane parā vargbʰārabʰr̥dyatʰā saṃvargam̐ sam̐ rayiṃ jaya
14.3.d: मा नो अग्ने महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा संवर्गꣳ सꣳ रयिं जय
14.3.e: Yea, come at milking-time, at early morning, at noon of day, and when the Sun is setting, By day, at night, with most auspicious favour! Not only now the draught hath drawn the Asvins. XVI Dawn

14.3.s: samasya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kr̥ṣṭayaḥ samudrāyeva sindʰavaḥ
14.3.d: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः
14.3.e: These Dawns have raised their banner: in the eastern half of middle air they spread abroad their shining light. Like heroes who prepare their weapons for the fray, the cows are coming on, the mothers, red of hue.

14.3.s: vi cidvr̥trasya dodʰataḥ śiro bibʰeda vr̥ṣṇinā vajreṇa śataparvaṇā
14.3.d: वि चिद्वृत्रस्य दोधतः शिरो बिभेद वृष्णिना वज्रेण शतपर्वणा
14.3.e: Rapidly have the ruddy beams of light shot up: the red cows have they harnessed, easy to be yoked. The Dawns have made their pathways as in former times: redhued, they have attained refulgent brilliancy.

14.3.s: ojastadasya titviṣa ubʰe yatsamavarttayat indraścarmeva rodasī
14.3.d: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्त्तयत् इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी
14.3.e: They sing their song like women active in their tasks, along their common path hither from far away, Bringing refreshment to the liberal devotee, yea, all things to the worshipper who pours the juice. XVII Asvins

14.3.s: sumanmā vasvī rantī sūnarī
14.3.d: सुमन्मा वस्वी रन्ती सूनरी
14.3.e: Agni is wakened: Surya riseth from the earth. Bright Dawn hath opened out the mighty twain with light. The Asvins have equipped their chariot for the course. God Savitar hath roused the world in sundry ways.

14.3.s: sarūpa vr̥ṣannā gahīmau bʰadrau dʰuryāvabʰi tāvimā upa sarpataḥ
14.3.d: सरूप वृषन्ना गहीमौ भद्रौ धुर्यावभि ताविमा उप सर्पतः
14.3.e: When, O ye Asvins, ye equip your mighty car, with fatness and with honey balm, ye twain, our power! To our devotion give victorious strength in war: may we win riches in the heroes' strife for spoil!

14.3.s: nīva śīrṣāṇi mr̥ḍʰvaṃ madʰya āpasya tiṣṭʰati śr̥ṅgebʰirdaśabʰirdiśan
14.3.d: नीव शीर्षाणि मृढ्वं मध्य आपस्य तिष्ठति शृङ्गेभिर्दशभिर्दिशन्
14.3.e: Nigh to us come the Asvins' lauded three wheeled car, the car laden with meath and drawn by fleet-foot steeds, Three-seated, opulent, bestowing all delight: may it bring weal to us, to cattle and to men! XVIII Soma Pavamana

14.3.s: panyaṃpanyamitsotāra ā dʰāvata madyāya somaṃ vīrāya śūrāya
14.3.d: पन्यंपन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय सोमं वीराय शूराय
14.3.e: Thy streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven, To bring a thousand stores of wealth.

14.3.s: eha harī brahmayujā śagmā vakṣataḥ sakʰāyam indraṃ gīrbʰirgirvaṇasam
14.3.d: एह हरी ब्रह्मयुजा शग्मा वक्षतः सखायम् इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्गिर्वणसम्
14.3.e: He, flows beholding on his way all well-beloved sacred lore, Green-tinted, brandishing his arms.

14.3.s: pātā vr̥trahā sutamā gʰā gamannāre asmat ni yamate śatamūtiḥ
14.3.d: पाता वृत्रहा सुतमा घा गमन्नारे अस्मत् नि यमते शतमूतिः
14.3.e: He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants, Sits as a falcon in the wood.

15.1.s: ā tvā viśantvindavaḥ samudramiva sindʰavaḥ na tvāmindrāti ricyate
15.1.d: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते
15.1.e: So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified. All treasures both of heaven and earth! I Soma Pavamana

15.1.s: vivyaktʰa mahinā vr̥ṣanbʰakṣam̐ somasya jāgr̥ve ya indra jaṭʰareṣu te
15.1.d: विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षꣳ सोमस्य जागृवे य इन्द्र जठरेषु ते
15.1.e: Forward have flowed the streams of power, of this the mighty one effused, Of him who waits upon the Gods.

15.1.s: araṃ ta indra kukṣaye somo bʰavatu vr̥trahan araṃ dʰāmabʰya indavaḥ
15.1.d: अरं त इन्द्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् अरं धामभ्य इन्दवः
15.1.e: The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the steed Born as thelight that merits laud.

15.1.s: jarābodʰa tadviviḍḍʰi viśeviśe yajñiyāya stomam̐ rudrāya dr̥śīkam
15.1.d: जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय स्तोमꣳ रुद्राय दृशीकम्
15.1.e: These things thou winnest quickly, while men cleanse thee, Soma, nobly rich! II Indra

15.1.s: sa no mahām̐ animāno dʰūmaketuḥ puruścandraḥ dʰiye vājāya hinvatu
15.1.d: स नो महाꣳ अनिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु
15.1.e: This Brahman, comer at the due time, named Indra, is renowned and praised.

15.1.s: sa revām̐ iva viśpatirdaivyaḥ ketuḥ śr̥ṇotu naḥ uktʰairagnirbr̥hadbʰānuḥ
15.1.d: स रेवाꣳ इव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शृणोतु नः उक्थैरग्निर्बृहद्भानुः
15.1.e: To thee alone, O Lord of Strength, go, as it were, all songs of praise.

15.1.s: tadvo gāya sute sacā puruhūtāya satvane śaṃ yadgave na śākine
15.1.d: तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने शं यद्गवे न शाकिने
15.1.e: Like streams of water on their way, let bounties, Indra, flow from thee! III Indra

15.1.s: na gʰā vasurni yamate dānaṃ vājasya gomataḥ yatsīmupaśravadgiraḥ
15.1.d: न घा वसुर्नि यमते दानं वाजस्य गोमतः यत्सीमुपश्रवद्गिरः
15.1.e: Even as a car to give us aid, we draw thee nigh to favour us, Strong in thy deeds, quelling attack, Indra, Lord, mightiest! of the brave.

15.1.s: kuvitsasya pra hi vrajaṃ gomantaṃ dasyuhā gamat śacībʰirapa no varat
15.1.d: कुवित्सस्य प्र हि व्रजं गोमन्तं दस्युहा गमत् शचीभिरप नो वरत्
15.1.e: Great in thou power and wisdom, strong, with thought that comprehendeth all! Wide hast thou spread in majesty.

15.1.s: idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredʰā ni dadʰe padam samūḍʰamasya pām̐sule
15.1.d: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम् समूढमस्य पाꣳसुले
15.1.e: Thou very mighty one, whose hands by virtue of thy greatness wield The golden bolt that beaks its way! IV Agni

15.1.s: trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇurgopā adābʰyaḥ ato dʰarmāṇi dʰārayan
15.1.d: त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः अतो धर्माणि धारयन्
15.1.e: He who hath lighted up the joyous castle, wise courser like the steed of cloudy heaven, Bright like the Sun with hundredfold existence

15.1.s: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe indrasya yujyaḥ sakʰā
15.1.d: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा
15.1.e: He, doubly born, hath spread in his effulgence through the three luminous realms, through all the regions, Best sacrificing Priest where waters gather.

15.1.s: tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam̐ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ divīva cakṣurātatam
15.1.d: तद्विष्णोः परमं पदꣳ सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः दिवीव चक्षुराततम्
15.1.e: Priest doubly born, he through his love of glory hath in his keeping all things worth the choosing. The man who brings him gifts hath noble offspring. V Agni

15.1.s: tadviprāso vipanyuvo jāgr̥vām̐saḥ samindʰate viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam
15.1.d: तद्विप्रासो विपन्युवो जागृवाꣳसः समिन्धते विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम्
15.1.e: Agni, with hymns may we now accomplish that which thou lovest, Strength, like a horse auspicious, with service!

15.1.s: ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇurvicakrame pr̥tʰivyā adʰi sānavi
15.1.d: अतो देवा अवन्तु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे पृथिव्या अधि सानवि
15.1.e: For, Agni, thou art now the promoter of strength auspicious, Lofty sacrifice, power effective.

15.1.s: mo ṣu tvā vāgʰataśca nāre asmanni rīraman ārāttādva sadʰamādaṃ na ā gahīha vā sannupa śrudʰi
15.1.d: मो षु त्वा वाघतश्च नारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् आरात्ताद्व सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि
15.1.e: Through these our praises, come thou to meet us, bright as the sunlight, Agni, kindly with all thy faces! VI Agni

15.1.s: ime hi te brahmakr̥taḥ sute sacā madʰau na makṣa āsate indre kāmaṃ jaritāro vasūyavo ratʰe na pādamā dadʰuḥ
15.1.d: इमे हि ते ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा मधौ न मक्ष आसते इन्द्रे कामं जरितारो वसूयवो रथे न पादमा दधुः
15.1.e: Immortal Jatavedas, thou bright-hued refulgent gift of Dawn. Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn!

15.1.s: astāvi manma pūrvyaṃ brahmendrāya vocata pūrvīrr̥tasya br̥hatīranūṣata stoturmedʰā asr̥kṣata
15.1.d: अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यं ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वोचत पूर्वीरृतस्य बृहतीरनूषत स्तोतुर्मेधा असृक्षत
15.1.e: For thou art offering-bearer, well-loved messenger, and charioteer of holy rites. Accordant with the Asvins and with Dawn grant us heroic strength and lofty fame! VII Indra

15.1.s: samindro rāyo br̥hatīradʰūnuta saṃ kṣoṇī samu sūryam sam̐ śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ saṃ gavāśiraḥ somā indramamandiṣuḥ
15.1.d: समिन्द्रो रायो बृहतीरधूनुत सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् सꣳ शुक्रासः शुचयः सं गवाशिरः सोमा इन्द्रममन्दिषुः
15.1.e: The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber who runs his circling course with many round him Behold the God's high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.

15.1.s: indrāya soma pātave vr̥tragʰne pari ṣicyase nare ca dakṣiṇāvate devāya sadanāsade
15.1.d: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे नरे च दक्षिणावते देवाय सदनासदे
15.1.e: Strong is the red Bird in his strength, great hero, who from of old bath had no nest to dwell in. That which he knows is truth and never idle: he wins and gives the wealth desired of many.

15.1.s: tam̐ sakʰāyaḥ purūrucaṃ yūyaṃ vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ aśyāma vājagandʰyam̐ sanema vājapastyam
15.1.d: तꣳ सखायः पुरूरुचं यूयं वयं च सूरयः अश्याम वाजगन्ध्यꣳ सनेम वाजपस्त्यम्
15.1.e: Through these Thunderer gained strong manly vigour, through whom he waxed in stren gth to slaughter Vritra; These who through might of actual operation sprang forth as Gods in course of Law and Order. VIII Maruts

15.1.s: pari tyam̐ haryatam̐ hariṃ babʰruṃ punanti vāreṇa yo devānviśvām̐ itpari madena saha gaccʰati
15.1.d: परि त्यꣳ हर्यतꣳ हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण यो देवान्विश्वाꣳ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति
15.1.e: Here is the Soma ready pressed: of this the Maruts, yea, of this Self-luminous, the Asvins, drink.

15.1.s: kastamindra tvāvaso martyo dadʰarṣati śraddʰā ittemagʰavan pārye divi vājī vājaṃ siṣāsati
15.1.d: कस्तमिन्द्र त्वावसो मर्त्यो दधर्षति श्रद्धा इत्तेमघवन् पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजं सिषासति
15.1.e: Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant, Drink Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.

15.1.s: magʰonaḥ sma vr̥trahatyeṣu codaya ye dadati priyā vasu tava praṇītī haryaśva sūribʰirviśvā tarema duritā
15.1.d: मघोनः स्म वृत्रहत्येषु चोदय ये ददति प्रिया वसु तव प्रणीती हर्यश्व सूरिभिर्विश्वा तरेम दुरिता
15.1.e: Yea, Indra, like the Hotar-priest, will in the early morning drink, At pleasure, of the milky juice: IX Surya

15.1.s: edu madʰormadintaram̐ siñcādʰvaryo andʰasaḥ evā hi vīra stavate sadāvr̥dʰaḥ
15.1.d: एदु मधोर्मदिन्तरꣳ सिञ्चाध्वर्यो अन्धसः एवा हि वीर स्तवते सदावृधः
15.1.e: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great. O most admired for greatness of thy majesty, God, by thy greatn.ess thou art great.

15.1.s: indra stʰātarharīṇāṃ na kiṣṭe pūrvyastutim udānam̐śa śavasā na bʰandanā
15.1.d: इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां न किष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम् उदानꣳश शवसा न भन्दना
15.1.e: Yea, Surya, thou art great in fame: thou evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods' High-Priest, divine, farspread unconquerable light. X Indra

15.1.s: taṃ vo vājānāṃ patimahūmahi śravasyavaḥ aprāyubʰirjñebʰirvāvr̥dʰenyam
15.1.d: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः अप्रायुभिर्ज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यम्
15.1.e: Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libations with thy bay steeds, come With bay steeds to our flowing juice!

15.1.s: taṃ gūrdʰayā svarṇaraṃ devāso devamaratiṃ dadʰanvire devatrā havyamūhiṣe
15.1.d: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे देवत्रा हव्यमूहिषे
15.1.e: Known as best Vritra-slayer erst, as Indra $atakratu, come With bay steeds to our flowing juice!

15.1.s: vibʰūtarātiṃ vipra citraśociṣamagnimīḍiṣva yanturam asya medʰasya somyasya sobʰare premadʰvarāya pūrvyam
15.1.d: विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीडिष्व यन्तुरम् अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यम्
15.1.e: For, Vritra-slayer, thou art he who drinks these drops of Soma come With bay steeds to our flowing juice! XI Indra

15.1.s: ā soma savāno adribʰistiro vārāṇyavyayā jano na puri camvorviśaddʰariḥ sado vaneṣu dadʰriṣe
15.1.d: आ सोम सवानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः सदो वनेषु दध्रिषे
15.1.e: Bring to the wise, the great, who waxeth mighty your offerings and make ready your devotion. Go forth to many tribes as man's controller!

15.1.s: sa māmr̥je tiro aṇvāni meṣyo mīḍvāntsaptirna vājayuḥ anumādyaḥ pavamāno manīṣibʰiḥ somo viprebʰirr̥kvabʰiḥ
15.1.d: स मामृजे तिरो अण्वानि मेष्यो मीड्वान्त्सप्तिर्न वाजयुः अनुमाद्यः पवमानो मनीषिभिः सोमो विप्रेभिरृक्वभिः
15.1.e: For Indra the sublime, the far-pervading, have singers generateo prayer and praises; The sages never violate his statutes.

15.1.s: vayamenamidā hyo 'pīpemeha vajriṇam tasmā u adya savane sutaṃ bʰarā nūnaṃ bʰūṣata śrute
15.1.d: वयमेनमिदा ह्यो ऽपीपेमेह वज्रिणम् तस्मा उ अद्य सवने सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते
15.1.e: The choirs have established Indra King for ever for victory him, whose anger is resistless: And for the bays' Lord strengthened those he loveth. XII Indra

15.1.s: vr̥kaścidasya vāraṇa urāmatʰirā vayuneṣu bʰūṣati semaṃ na stomaṃ jujuṣāṇa ā gahīndra pra citrayā dʰiyā
15.1.d: वृकश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति सेमं न स्तोमं जुजुषाण आ गहीन्द्र प्र चित्रया धिया
15.1.e: If I, O Indra, were the lord of riches ample as thine own, I would support the singer, God who scatterest wealth! and, not abandon him to woe.

15.1.s: indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ pari vājeṣu bʰūṣatʰaḥ tadvāṃ ceti pra vīryam
15.1.d: इन्द्राग्नी रोचना दिवः परि वाजेषु भूषथः तद्वां चेति प्र वीर्यम्
15.1.e: Each day would I enrich the man who sang my praise, in whatsoever place he were. No kinship is there better, Maghavan, than thine: a father even, is no more. XIII Indra

15.1.s: indrāgnī apasaspari upa pra yanti dʰītayaḥ r̥tasya patʰyā anu
15.1.d: इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्परि उप प्र यन्ति धीतयः ऋतस्य पथ्या अनु
15.1.e: Here thou the call of the juice-drinking press-stone: mark thou the sage's hymn who sings and lauds thee! Take to thine inmost self these adorations!

15.1.s: indrāgnī taviṣāṇi vām sadʰastʰāni prayām̐si ca yuvoraptūryaṃ hitam
15.1.d: इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणि वाम् सधस्थानि प्रयाꣳसि च युवोरप्तूर्यं हितम्
15.1.e: I know and ne'er forget the hymns and praises of thee, theconqueror, of thy power immortal. Thy name I ever utter, self-refulgent!

15.1.s: ka īṃ veda sute sacā pibantaṃ kadvayo dadʰe ayaṃ yaḥ puro vibʰinattyojasā mandānaḥ śiprayandʰasaḥ
15.1.d: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्रयन्धसः
15.1.e: Among mankind many are thy libations, and many a time the pious sage invokes thee. O Maghavan, be not long distant from us! XIV Indra

15.1.s: dānā mr̥go na vāraṇaḥ purutrā caratʰaṃ dadʰe na kiṣṭvā ni yamadā sute gamo mahām̐ścarasyojasā
15.1.d: दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे न किष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महाꣳश्चरस्योजसा
15.1.e: Sing strength to Indra that shall. set his chariot in the foremost place! Giver of room in closest fight, slayer of foes in shock of war, be thou our great encorager! Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of our weak mies!

15.1.s: ya ugraḥ sannaniṣṭr̥taḥ stʰiro raṇāya sam̐skr̥taḥ yadi stoturmagʰavā śr̥ṇavaddʰavaṃ nendro yoṣatyā gamat
15.1.d: य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृतः स्थिरो रणाय सꣳस्कृतः यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत्
15.1.e: Thou didst destroy the Dragon: thou sentest the rivers down to Earth. Foeless, O Indra, wast thou born. Thou tendest well each choicest thing. Therefore we draw us close to thee. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of our weak enemies! Destroyed be all malignitics and all our enemy's designs!

15.1.s: pavamānā asr̥kṣata somāḥ śukrāsa indavaḥ abʰi viśvāni kāvyā
15.1.d: पवमाना असृक्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इन्दवः अभि विश्वानि काव्या
15.1.e: Thy bolt thou castest at the foe, O Indra, who would smite us dead: thy liberal bounty gives us wealth. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of our weak enemies! XV Indra

15.1.s: pavamānā divasparyantarikṣādasr̥kṣata pr̥tʰivyā adʰi sānavi
15.1.d: पवमाना दिवस्पर्यन्तरिक्षादसृक्षत पृथिव्या अधि सानवि
15.1.e: Rich be the praiser of one rich and liberal, Lord of days! like thee: High rank be his who lauds the juice!

15.1.s: pavamānāsa āśavaḥ śubʰrā asr̥gramindavaḥ gʰnanto viśvā apa dviṣaḥ
15.1.d: पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा असृग्रमिन्दवः घ्नन्तो विश्वा अप द्विषः
15.1.e: His wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne'er found out recited laud, Nor song of praises that is sung.

15.1.s: tośā vr̥trahaṇā huve sajitvānāparājitā indrāgnī vājasātamā
15.1.d: तोशा वृत्रहणा हुवे सजित्वानापराजिता इन्द्राग्नी वाजसातमा
15.1.e: Give us not, Indra, as a prey unto the scornful or the proud: Help, mighty one, with power and might! XVI Indra

15.1.s: pra vāmarcantyuktʰino nītʰāvido jaritāraḥ indrāgnī iṣa ā vr̥ṇe
15.1.d: प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे
15.1.e: Come hither, Indra, with thy bays, come thou to Kanva's eulogy! Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

15.1.s: indrāgnī navatiṃ puro dāsapatnīradʰūnutam sākamekena karmaṇā
15.1.d: इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतम् साकमेकेन कर्मणा
15.1.e: The stones' rim shakes the Soma here like a wolf worrying a sheep. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day I have gone to heaven.

15.1.s: upa tvā raṇvasandr̥śaṃ prayasvantaḥ sahaskr̥ta agne sasr̥jmahe giraḥ
15.1.d: उप त्वा रण्वसन्दृशं प्रयस्वन्तः सहस्कृत अग्ने ससृज्महे गिरः
15.1.e: May the stone bring thee as it speaks, the Soma-stone with ringing voice! Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven. XVII Soma Pavamana

15.1.s: upa ccʰāyāmiva gʰr̥ṇeraganma śarma te vayam agne hiraṇyasandr̥śaḥ
15.1.d: उप च्छायामिव घृणेरगन्म शर्म ते वयम् अग्ने हिरण्यसन्दृशः
15.1.e: For Indra flow most rich in sweets, O Soma, bringing him delight!

15.1.s: ya ugra iva śaryahā tigmaśr̥ṅgo na vam̐sagaḥ agne puro rurojitʰa
15.1.d: य उग्र इव शर्यहा तिग्मशृङ्गो न वꣳसगः अग्ने पुरो रुरोजिथ
15.1.e: Bright, meditating sacred song, these juices have sent Vayu forth.

15.1.s: r̥tāvānaṃ vaiśvānaramr̥tasya jyotiṣaspatim ajasraṃ gʰarmamīmahe
15.1.d: ऋतावानं वैश्वानरमृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पतिम् अजस्रं घर्ममीमहे
15.1.e: They were sent forth to feast the Gods, like chariots speeding in the race. XVIII Agni

15.1.s: ya idaṃ pratipapratʰe yajñasya svaruttiran r̥tūnutsr̥jate vaśī
15.1.d: य इदं प्रतिपप्रथे यज्ञस्य स्वरुत्तिरन् ऋतूनुत्सृजते वशी
15.1.e: Agni I deem our Hotar priest, munificent wealth-giver, Son of Strength, who knoweth all that is even as the Sage who knoweth all. Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods, he when the flame hath sprung forth from the holy oil, the offered fatness, longs for it as it grows bright.

15.1.s: agniḥ priyeṣu dʰāmasu kāmo bʰūtasya bʰavyasya sabʰrāḍeko vi rājati
15.1.d: अग्निः प्रियेषु धामसु कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य सभ्राडेको वि राजति
15.1.e: We, sacrificing, call on the best worshipper thee eldest of Angirasas, singer! with hyrnns, thee, brilliant one! with singers' hymn; Thee, wandering round, as 'twere the sky, thee who art Hotar-priest of men, whom, Bull with hair of flame, the people must observe, tile people that he speed them on.

15.2.s: agniḥ pratnena janmanā śumbʰānastanvā3m̐ svām kavirvipreṇa vavr̥dʰe
15.2.d: अग्निः प्रत्नेन जन्मना शुम्भानस्तन्वा३ꣳ स्वाम् कविर्विप्रेण ववृधे
15.2.e: He with his blazing Power refulgent far and wide, he verily it iswho conquers demon foes, conquers the demons like an axe: At whose close touch things solid partg and what is stable yields he keeps his ground and flinches not,like trees. Subduing all from the skilled archer flinches not. I Agni

15.2.s: ūrjjo napātamā huve 'gniṃ pāvakaśociṣam asminyajñe svadʰvare
15.2.d: ऊर्ज्जो नपातमा हुवे ऽग्निं पावकशोचिषम् अस्मिन्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे
15.2.e: O Agni, strength and fame are thine: thy fires blaze forth on high, O thou refulgent God! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper with power, the wealth that merits laud.

15.2.s: sa no mitramahastvamagne śukreṇa śociṣā devairā satsi barhiṣi
15.2.d: स नो मित्रमहस्त्वमग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि
15.2.e: With brilliantg purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy mothers, aidest them as son; thou joinest close the earth and heaven.

15.2.s: utte śuṣmāso astʰū rakṣo bʰindanto adrivaḥ nudasva yāḥ parispr̥dʰaḥ
15.2.d: उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः
15.2.e: O Jatavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs! In thee have they heaped viands various, many formed; wealthborn, of wondrous help are they.

15.2.s: ayā nijagʰnirojasā ratʰasaṅge dʰane hite stavā abibʰyuṣā hr̥dā
15.2.d: अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसङ्गे धने हिते स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा
15.2.e: Agni, spread forth, as ruler, over living things: give wealth, to us, immortal God! Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to beauteous Power.

15.2.s: asya vratāni nādʰr̥ṣe pavamānasya dūḍʰyā ruja yastvā pr̥tanyati
15.2.d: अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति
15.2.e: I laud the Sage, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control. Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, thou givest wealth that wins success.

15.2.s: tam̐ hinvanti madacyutam̐ hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam indumindrāya matsaram
15.2.d: तꣳ हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतꣳ हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम्
15.2.e: The men have set before them, for his favour, Agni, strong, visible to all, the holy. Thee, Lord divine, with ears to hear, most famous, mens' generations magnify with praise-songs. II Agni

15.2.s: ā mandrairindra haribʰiryāhi mayūraromabʰiḥ mā tvā ke cinni yemurinna pāśino 'ti dʰanveva tām̐ ihi
15.2.d: आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः मा त्वा के चिन्नि येमुरिन्न पाशिनो ऽति धन्वेव ताꣳ इहि
15.2.e: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.

15.2.s: vr̥trakʰādo valam̐ rujaḥ purāṃ darmo apāmajaḥ stʰātā ratʰasya haryorabʰisvara indro dr̥ḍʰā cidārujaḥ
15.2.d: वृत्रखादो वलꣳ रुजः पुरां दर्मो अपामजः स्थाता रथस्य हर्योरभिस्वर इन्द्रो दृढा चिदारुजः
15.2.e: Thy spark is black and crackling; kindled in due time, O bounteous, it is taken up. Thou art the dear friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night. III Agni

15.2.s: gambʰīrām̐ udadʰīm̐riva kratuṃ puṣyasi gā iva pra sugopā yavasaṃ dʰenavo yatʰā hradaṃ kulyā ivāśata
15.2.d: गम्भीराꣳ उदधीꣳरिव क्रतुं पुष्यसि गा इव प्र सुगोपा यवसं धेनवो यथा ह्रदं कुल्या इवाशत
15.2.e: Him, duly coming, as their germ have plants received: this Agni have maternal Waters brought to life. So, in like manner, do the forest trees and plants bear him within them and produce him evermore. IV Agni

15.2.s: yatʰā gauro apā kr̥taṃ tr̥ṣyannetyaveriṇam āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyamā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba
15.2.d: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब
15.2.e: Agni grows bright for Indra: he shines far resplendent in the sky: He sends forth offspring like a queen. V Agni

15.2.s: mandantu tvā magʰavannindrendavo rādʰodeyāya sunvate āmuṣyā somamapibaścamū sutaṃ jyeṣṭʰaṃ taddadʰiṣe sahaḥ
15.2.d: मन्दन्तु त्वा मघवन्निन्द्रेन्दवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं ज्येष्ठं तद्दधिषे सहः
15.2.e: The sacred hymns love him who wakes and watches: to him who watches the holy verses. This Soma saith to him Who wake my dwelling in thy friendship. VI Agni

15.2.s: tvamaṅga pra śum̐siṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭʰa martyam na tvadanyo magʰavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ
15.2.d: त्वमङ्ग प्र शुꣳसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम् न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः
15.2.e: Agni is watchful, and the Richas love him: Agni is watchful, Sama hymns approach him. Agni is watchful, to him saith this Soma, I rest and have my dwelling in thy friendship. VII Gods

15.2.s: mā te rādʰām̐si mā ta ūtayo vaso 'smānkadā canā dabʰan viśvā ca na upamimīhi mānuṣa vasūni carṣaṇibʰya ā
15.2.d: मा ते राधाꣳसि मा त ऊतयो वसो ऽस्मान्कदा चना दभन् विश्वा च न उपमिमीहि मानुष वसूनि चर्षणिभ्य आ
15.2.e: Praise to the friends who sit in front! to those seated together,praise I use the hundred-footed speech speech.

15.2.s: prati ṣyā sūnarī janī vyuccʰantī pari svasuḥ divo adarśi duhitā
15.2.d: प्रति ष्या सूनरी जनी व्युच्छन्ती परि स्वसुः दिवो अदर्शि दुहिता
15.2.e: I use the hundred-footed speech, I sing what hath a thousand paths, Gayatra, Trishtup, Jagat hymn.

15.2.s: aśveva citrāruṣī mātā gavāmr̥tāvarī sakʰā bʰūdaśvinoruṣāḥ
15.2.d: अश्वेव चित्रारुषी माता गवामृतावरी सखा भूदश्विनोरुषाः
15.2.e: Gayatra, Trishtup, Jagat hymn,the forms united and complete, Have the Gods made familiar friends. VIII Agni

15.2.s: uta sakʰāsyaśvinoruta mātā gavāmasi utoṣo vasva īśiṣe
15.2.d: उत सखास्यश्विनोरुत माता गवामसि उतोषो वस्व ईशिषे
15.2.e: Agni, is light, light is Agni, Indra is light, light is Indra Surya is light, light is Surya.

15.2.s: eṣo uṣā apūrvya vyuccʰati priyā divaḥ stuṣe vāmaśvinā br̥hat
15.2.d: एषो उषा अपूर्व्य व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत्
15.2.e: O Agni, turn again with strength, turn thou again with food and life: Save us again from grief and woe!

15.2.s: yā dasrā sindʰumātarā manotarā rayīṇām dʰiyā devā vasuvidā
15.2.d: या दस्रा सिन्धुमातरा मनोतरा रयीणाम् धिया देवा वसुविदा
15.2.e: O Agni, turn again with wealth sprinkle thou us from everyside. With thine own all-supporting stream! IX Indra

15.2.s: vacyante vāṃ kakuhāso jūrṇāyāmadʰi viṣṭapi yadvām̐ ratʰo vibʰiṣpatāt
15.2.d: वच्यन्ते वां ककुहासो जूर्णायामधि विष्टपि यद्वाꣳ रथो विभिष्पतात्
15.2.e: If I, O Indra, were like thee, the single ruler over wealth. My worshipper should be rich in kine.

15.2.s: uṣastaccitramā bʰarāsmabʰyaṃ vājinīvati yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dʰāmahe
15.2.d: उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे
15.2.e: I should be fain, O Lord of power, to strengthen and enrich thesage, Where I the ford of herds of kine.

15.2.s: uṣo adyeha gomatyaśvāvati vibʰāvari revadasme vyuccʰa sūnr̥tāvati
15.2.d: उषो अद्येह गोमत्यश्वावति विभावरि रेवदस्मे व्युच्छ सूनृतावति
15.2.e: Thy goodness, Indra, is a cow yielding in plenty kine and steeds. To worshippers who press the juice. X The Waters

15.2.s: yuṅkṣvā hi vājinīvatyaśvām̐ adyāruṇām̐ uṣaḥ atʰā no viśvā saubʰagānyā vaha
15.2.d: युङ्क्ष्वा हि वाजिनीवत्यश्वाꣳ अद्यारुणाꣳ उषः अथा नो विश्वा सौभगान्या वह
15.2.e: Yea, Waters, ye bring health and bliss: so help ye us to energy. That we may look on great delight!

15.2.s: aśvinā vartirasmadā gomaddasrā hiraṇyavat arvāgratʰam̐ samanasā ni yaccʰatam
15.2.d: अश्विना वर्तिरस्मदा गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् अर्वाग्रथꣳ समनसा नि यच्छतम्
15.2.e: Give us a portion of the dew, the most auspicious that ye have, Like mothers in their longing love!

15.2.s: eha devā mayobʰuvā dasrā hiraṇyavarttanī uṣarbudʰo vahantu somapītaye
15.2.d: एह देवा मयोभुवा दस्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी उषर्बुधो वहन्तु सोमपीतये
15.2.e: For you we gladly go to hirn to whose abode ye speed us on, And, Waters, give us procreant strength! XI Vata

15.2.s: yāvittʰā ślokamā divo jyotirjanāya cakratʰuḥ ā na ūrjaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvam
15.2.d: यावित्था श्लोकमा दिवो ज्योतिर्जनाय चक्रथुः आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवम्
15.2.e: May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life!

15.2.s: agniṃ taṃ manye yo vasurastaṃ yaṃ yanti dʰenavaḥ astamarvanta āśavostaṃ nityāso vājina iṣam̐ stotr̥bʰya ā bʰara
15.2.d: अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
15.2.e: Thou art our father, Vata, yea, thou art our brother and our friend: So give us strength that we may live!

15.2.s: agnirhi vājinaṃ viśe dadāti viśvacarṣaṇiḥ agnī rāye svābʰuvam̐ sa prīto yāti vāryamiṣam̐ stotr̥bʰya ā bʰara
15.2.d: अग्निर्हि वाजिनं विशे ददाति विश्वचर्षणिः अग्नी राये स्वाभुवꣳ स प्रीतो याति वार्यमिषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
15.2.e: The store of Amrit that laid away yonder, O Vata, in thine home-- Give us strength that we may live! XII Agni

15.2.s: so agniryo vasurgr̥ṇe saṃ yamāyanti dʰenavaḥ samarvanto ragʰudruvaḥ sam̐ sujātāsaḥ sūraya iṣam̐ stotr̥bʰya ā bʰara
15.2.d: सो अग्निर्यो वसुर्गृणे सं यमायन्ति धेनवः समर्वन्तो रघुद्रुवः सꣳ सुजातासः सूरय इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
15.2.e: The fleet steed wearing divers forms, the eagle bearing his golden raiment to his birthplace, Clothed in due season with the light of Surya, red, hath begot the sacrifice in person.

15.2.s: mahe no adya bodʰayoṣo rāye divitmatī yatʰā cinno abodʰayaḥ satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnr̥te
15.2.d: महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते
15.2.e: Multiform seed he laid in waters, lustre which gathered on the earth and there developed. In the mid-air establishing his greatness, he cries aloud, seed of the vigorous courser.

15.2.s: yā sunītʰe śaucadratʰe vyauccʰo duhitardivaḥ sā vyuccʰa sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnr̥te
15.2.d: या सुनीथे शौचद्रथे व्यौच्छो दुहितर्दिवः सा व्युच्छ सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते
15.2.e: He hath, enduing thousand robes that suit him, as sacrifice upheld the light of Surya, Giver of ample gifts in hundreds, thousands, supporter of the heavens, earth's Lord and ruler. XIII Vena

15.2.s: sā no adyābʰaradvasurvyuccʰā duhitardivaḥ yo vyauccʰaḥ sahīyasi satyaśravasi yāyye sujāte aśvasūnr̥te
15.2.d: सा नो अद्याभरद्वसुर्व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः यो व्यौच्छः सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि याय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते
15.2.e: They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strong-winged bird that mounteth sky-ward; On thee with wings of gold, Varuna's envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.

15.2.s: prati priyatamam̐ ratʰaṃ vr̥śaṇaṃ vasuvāhanam stotā vāmaśvināvr̥ṣi stomebʰirbʰūṣati prati mādʰvī mama śrutam̐ havam
15.2.d: प्रति प्रियतमꣳ रथं वृशणं वसुवाहनम् स्तोता वामश्विनावृषि स्तोमेभिर्भूषति प्रति माध्वी मम श्रुतꣳ हवम्
15.2.e: Erect, to heaven hath the Gandharva mounted, pointing at us his many-coloured weapons: Clad in sweet raiment beautiful to look on, for he, as light, produceth forms that please us..

15.3.s: atyāyātamaśvinā tiro viśvā aham̐ sanā dasrā hiraṇyavarttanī suṣumṇā sindʰuvāhasā mādʰvī mama śrutam̐ havam
15.3.d: अत्यायातमश्विना तिरो विश्वा अहꣳ सना दस्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी सुषुम्णा सिन्धुवाहसा माध्वी मम श्रुतꣳ हवम्
15.3.e: When as a spark he cometh ilear the ocean, looking with vulture's eye as Law commandeth, His lustre, joying in its own bright splendour, maketh dear glories in the loftiest region. I Indra

15.3.s: ā no ratnāni bibʰratāvaśvinā gaccʰataṃ yuvam rudrā hiraṇyavarttanī juṣāṇā vājinīvasū mādʰvī mama śrutam̐ havam
15.3.d: आ नो रत्नानि बिभ्रतावश्विना गच्छतं युवम् रुद्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी जुषाणा वाजिनीवसू माध्वी मम श्रुतꣳ हवम्
15.3.e: Swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people. With eyes that close not, bellowing, sole hero, Indra subdued at once a hundred armies.

15.3.s: abodʰyagniḥ samidʰā janānāṃ prati dʰenumivāyatīmuṣāsam yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānāḥ pra bʰānavaḥ sasrate nākamaccʰa
15.3.d: अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम् यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सस्रते नाकमच्छ
15.3.e: With him loud-roaring, ever watchful victcr, bold, hard to overthrow, rouser of battle, Indra. the strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye heroes, now, now vanquish in the combat!

15.3.s: abodʰi hotā yajatʰāya devānūrdʰvo agniḥ sumanāḥ prātarastʰāt samiddʰasya ruśadadarśi pājo mahāndevastamaso niramoci
15.3.d: अबोधि होता यजथाय देवानूर्ध्वो अग्निः सुमनाः प्रातरस्थात् समिद्धस्य रुशददर्शि पाजो महान्देवस्तमसो निरमोचि
15.3.e: He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band brings hosts together, Foe-conquering strong of arm the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows. II Brihaspati. Indra

15.3.s: yadīṃ gaṇasya raśanāmajīgaḥ śuciraṅkte śucibʰirgobʰiragniḥ āddakṣiṇā yujyate vājayantyuttānāmūrdʰvo adʰayajjuhūbʰiḥ
15.3.d: यदीं गणस्य रशनामजीगः शुचिरङ्क्ते शुचिभिर्गोभिरग्निः आद्दक्षिणा युज्यते वाजयन्त्युत्तानामूर्ध्वो अधयज्जुहूभिः
15.3.e: Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen! Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies! 2, Conspicuous. by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing, The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kinewinner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra!

15.3.s: idam̐ śreṣṭʰaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirāgāccitraḥ praketo ajaniṣṭa vibʰvā yatʰā prasūtā savituḥ savāyaivā rātryuṣase yonimāraik
15.3.d: इदꣳ श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरागाच्चित्रः प्रकेतो अजनिष्ट विभ्वा यथा प्रसूता सवितुः सवायैवा रात्र्युषसे योनिमारैक्
15.3.e: Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it-- Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage! III Indra. Brihaspati

15.3.s: ruśādvatsā ruśatī śvetyāgādāraigu kr̥ṣṇā sadanānyasyāḥ samānabandʰū amr̥te anūcī dyāvā varṇaṃ carata āmināne
15.3.d: रुशाद्वत्सा रुशती श्वेत्यागादारैगु कृष्णा सदनान्यस्याः समानबन्धू अमृते अनूची द्यावा वर्णं चरत आमिनाने
15.3.e: Piercing with conquering strength the cow-stalls, Indra, pitiless hero with unbounded anger, Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless--may he protect our armies in our battles!

15.3.s: samāno adʰvā svasroranantastamanyānyā carato devaśiṣṭe na metʰete na tastʰatuḥ sumeke naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe
15.3.d: समानो अध्वा स्वस्रोरनन्तस्तमन्यान्या चरतो देवशिष्टे न मेथेते न तस्थतुः सुमेके नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे
15.3.e: Indra guide these! Brihaspati, and Soma, the guerdon and the sacrifice precede them; And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish!

15.3.s: ā bʰātyagniruṣasāmanīkamudviprāṇāṃ devayā vāco astʰuḥ arvāñcā nūnam̐ ratʰyeha yātaṃ pīpivām̐samaśvinā gʰarmamaccʰa
15.3.d: आ भात्यग्निरुषसामनीकमुद्विप्राणां देवया वाचो अस्थुः अर्वाञ्चा नूनꣳ रथ्येह यातं पीपिवाꣳसमश्विना घर्ममच्छ
15.3.e: Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna the Maruts, and Adityas! Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, hightninded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble. IV Indra.Maruts

15.3.s: na sam̐skr̥taṃ pra mimīto gamiṣṭʰānti nūnamaśvinopastuteha divābʰipitvevasāgamiṣṭʰā pratyavarttiṃ dāśuṣe śambʰaviṣṭʰā
15.3.d: न सꣳस्कृतं प्र मिमीतो गमिष्ठान्ति नूनमश्विनोपस्तुतेह दिवाभिपित्वेवसागमिष्ठा प्रत्यवर्त्तिं दाशुषे शम्भविष्ठा
15.3.e: Bristle thou up, O Maghavan, our weapons: excite the spirits, of my warring heroes! Urge on the strong steed's might, O Vyitra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward

15.3.s: utā yātam̐ saṃgave prātarahno madʰyandina uditā sūryasya divā naktamavasā śantamena nedānīṃ pītiraśvinā tatāna
15.3.d: उता यातꣳ संगवे प्रातरह्नो मध्यन्दिन उदिता सूर्यस्य दिवा नक्तमवसा शन्तमेन नेदानीं पीतिरश्विना ततान
15.3.e: May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be ther arrows of our army! May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods, protect us in the shout of onset!

15.3.s: etā u tyā uṣasaḥ ketumakrata pūrve ardʰe rajaso bʰānumañjate niṣkr̥ṇvānā āyudʰānīva dʰr̥ṣṇavaḥ prati gāvo 'ruṣīryanti mātaraḥ
15.3.d: एता उ त्या उषसः केतुमक्रत पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो भानुमञ्जते निष्कृण्वाना आयुधानीव धृष्णवः प्रति गावो ऽरुषीर्यन्ति मातरः
15.3.e: That army of the foemen, O ye Maruts, which, striving in its. mighty strength, approaches, Hide ye and bury it in pathless darkness that not a man oF them may know the other! V Agha

15.3.s: udapaptannaruṇā bʰānavo vr̥tʰā svāyujo aruṣīrgā ayukṣata akrannuṣāso vayunāni pūrvatʰā ruśantaṃ bʰānumaruṣīraśiśrayuḥ
15.3.d: उदपप्तन्नरुणा भानवो वृथा स्वायुजो अरुषीर्गा अयुक्षत अक्रन्नुषासो वयुनानि पूर्वथा रुशन्तं भानुमरुषीरशिश्रयुः
15.3.e: Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies, and depart, O Agha! Attack them, set their hearts on fare with sorrows; so let our foes abide in utter darkness!

15.3.s: arcanti nārīrapaso na viṣṭibʰiḥ samānena yojanenā parāvataḥ iṣaṃ vahantīḥ sukr̥te sudānave viśvedaha yajamānāya sunvate
15.3.d: अर्चन्ति नारीरपसो न विष्टिभिः समानेन योजनेना परावतः इषं वहन्तीः सुकृते सुदानवे विश्वेदह यजमानाय सुन्वते
15.3.e: Advance, O heroes, win the day, May Indra be your sure defence! Mighty and awful be your arms, that none may wound or injure you!

15.3.s: abodʰyagnirjma udeti sūryo vyū3ṣāścandrā mahyāvo arciṣā āyukṣātāmaśvinā yātave ratʰaṃ prāsāvīddevaḥ savitā jagatpr̥tʰak
15.3.d: अबोध्यग्निर्ज्म उदेति सूर्यो व्यू३षाश्चन्द्रा मह्यावो अर्चिषा आयुक्षातामश्विना यातवे रथं प्रासावीद्देवः सविता जगत्पृथक्
15.3.e: Loosed from the bowstring fly away, thou arrows sharpened by our prayer! Go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one be left alive! VI Indra and others

15.3.s: yadyuñjātʰe vr̥ṣaṇamaśvinā ratʰaṃ gʰr̥tena no madʰunā kṣatramukṣatam asmākaṃ brahma pr̥tanāsu jinvataṃ vayaṃ dʰanā śūrasātā bʰajemahi
15.3.d: यद्युञ्जाथे वृषणमश्विना रथं घृतेन नो मधुना क्षत्रमुक्षतम् अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु जिन्वतं वयं धना शूरसाता भजेमहि
15.3.e: Let ravens and strong-pinioned birds pursue them: yea, let that army be the food of vultures! Indra, let none escape, no sin-remover: behind them all let following birds be gathered!

15.3.s: arvāṅtricakro madʰuvāhano ratʰo jīrāśvo aśvinoryātu suṣṭutaḥ trivandʰuro magʰavā viśvasaubʰagaḥ śaṃ na ā vakṣaddvipade catuṣpade
15.3.d: अर्वाङ्त्रिचक्रो मधुवाहनो रथो जीराश्वो अश्विनोर्यातु सुष्टुतः त्रिवन्धुरो मघवा विश्वसौभगः शं न आ वक्षद्द्विपदे चतुष्पदे
15.3.e: This host of foemen Maghavan! that cometh on in warlike show-- Meet it, O Vritra-slayer, thou, Indra, and Agni, with your flames!

15.3.s: pra te dʰārā asaścato divo na yanti vr̥ṣṭayaḥ accʰā vājam̐ sahasriṇam
15.3.d: प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वृष्टयः अच्छा वाजꣳ सहस्रिणम्
15.3.e: There where the flights of arrows fall like boys whose locks are yet unshorn. Even there may Brahmanaspati, may Aditi protect us well, protect us well through all our days! VII Indra

15.3.s: abʰi priyāṇi kāvyā viśvā cakṣāṇo arṣati haristuñjāna āyudʰā
15.3.d: अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा
15.3.e: Drive Rakshasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vritra's jaws: O Vritra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us!

15.3.s: sa marmr̥jāna āyubʰiribʰo rājeva suvrataḥ śyeno na vam̐su ṣīdati
15.3.d: स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः श्येनो न वꣳसु षीदति
15.3.e: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury!

15.3.s: sa no viśvā divo vasūto pr̥tʰivyā adʰi punāna indavā bʰara
15.3.d: स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि पुनान इन्दवा भर
15.3.e: Strong, ever-youthful are the arms of Indra, fair unassailable, never to be vanquished: These first let him employ when need hath come on us, wherewith the Asuras' great might was overthrown. VIII Soma, Varuna

15.3.s: prāsya dʰārā akṣaranvr̥ṣṇaḥ sutasyaujasā devām̐ anu prabʰūṣataḥ
15.3.d: प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसा देवाꣳ अनु प्रभूषतः
15.3.e: Thy vital parts I cover with thine armour: with immortality King Soma clothe thee! Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy victory may Gods be joyful!

15.3.s: saptiṃ mr̥janti vedʰaso gr̥ṇantaḥ kāravo girā jyotirjajñānamuktʰyam
15.3.d: सप्तिं मृजन्ति वेधसो गृणन्तः कारवो गिरा ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यम्
15.3.e: Blind, O my foemen, shall ye be, even as headless serpents are May Indra slay each best of you when Agni's flame hath struck you down!

15.3.s: suṣahā soma tāni te punānāya prabʰūvaso vardʰā samudramuktʰyam
15.3.d: सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम्
15.3.e: Whoso would kill us, whether he be a stranger foe or one of us, May all the Gods discomfit him! My nearest, closest mail is prayer, my closest armour and defence. IX Indra. All-Gods

15.3.s: eṣa brahmā ya r̥tviya indro nāma śruto gr̥ṇe
15.3.d: एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्विय इन्द्रो नाम श्रुतो गृणे
15.3.e: Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foe and scatter those who hate us!

15.3.s: tvāmiccʰavasaspate yanti giro na saṃyataḥ
15.3.d: त्वामिच्छवसस्पते यन्ति गिरो न संयतः
15.3.e: Gods, may our ears hear that which is auspicious, may our eyes see that which is good, ye holy! Extolling you with still strong limbs and bodies, may we attain the age by Gods appointed!

15.3.s: vi srutayo yatʰā patʰā indra tvadyantu rātayaḥ
15.3.d: वि स्रुतयो यथा पथा इन्द्र त्वद्यन्तु रातयः
15.3.e: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra bless us, may Pushan bless us, master of all riches! May Tarkshya with uninjured fellies bless us! Brihaspati bestow on us his favour! Brihaspati bestow on us his favour! Sacred Texts Hinduism « Previous: SONGS OF KABÎR Index Next: Title Page »
